name: BL-010 criteria, addendum 8: the gate numbers of addendum 6 as keys, so the check script reads them instead of restating them
adds_to: bl010_criteria_addendum_6.json (gates G1 to G6) and addendum 7 (the supplement's repeats of G1, G2, G3, G5)
rule: Restates, as machine-readable keys, numbers addendum 6 gave in words. Nothing here changes a threshold, a variant or a verdict; the check already ran on these numbers. Never edited after the fact: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Code review of PR 285, finding 4: the package rule is that code never restates a threshold (criteria.py reads the committed files), and scripts/bl010_four_sectors_check.py had retyped the numbers as constants. The script now reads them from here.
